risk_summary: The excerpt provides detailed discussion of insurance reserves, reinsurance collectibility, investment valuation, tax estimates, and catastrophe exposure, but relies heavily on qualitative assumptions and standard forward-looking caveats. Material downside risks include long-term-care reserve inadequacy, restricted premium-rate approvals, credit losses, reinsurer default, and catastrophe volatility; reported catastrophe losses were $247 million in 2022 versus $397 million in 2021.
